answers.reason: The research associate holds no office and has no designated seat in this central body.
Budget planning is a high-level administrative round where the research associate has no office or seat.
The research associate holds no office and the description does not provide a seat for them on this committee.
The research associate does not hold a high office or an explicit representative seat on the faculty council.
Without an office or an explicitly mentioned seat, the research associate is not eligible for this formal commission.
The research associate holds no office and has no designated seat on the examination board.
Allocating faculty research grants is a higher-level decision in which a research associate without office has no seat.
As teaching staff of the faculty, a research associate may take part in a working group revising course modules.

Planning the orientation week is a low-level task open to faculty members involved in teaching.
